title: The specified tensor-adjoint selected derived transition
statement:
For a derived system N over B_r, put a=t_r(m), b=t_r(m+1). The scalar adjunct of the actual derived transition of its left extension from m+1 to m is tensor extension of the upper evaluation comparison, the canonical associator to B_m tensor over B_r(b), the inverse associator through B_r(a), tensor extension of the scalar adjunct of the actual transition N_b→Res N_a, and the inverse lower evaluation comparison, in that order. Equal consecutive selected indices are included.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe u v w
variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
  [EssentiallySmall.{w} C]
  [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
  [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
  (S : SystemScalarAssignment (J := J))
  (B : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w}) (r : ℕ ↪o ℕ)
theorem systemSelectedDerivedTransition (m : ℕ)
    (N : DerivedCategory (StrictRingSystem (selectedSystemRings B r))) :
    ((systemDerivedTensorAdj S B (Nat.le_succ m)).homEquiv _ _).symm
      ((systemDerivedTransition B (Nat.le_succ m)).app
        ((systemSelectedDerivedExtension B r S (systemTensorCoherence S)).derived.obj N)) =
    (systemDerivedTensor S B (Nat.le_succ m)).map
      ((systemSelectedDerivedBelow B r (m + 1) S (systemTensorCoherence S)).hom.app N) ≫
    ((systemTensorCoherence S).derivedAssoc B (Nat.le_succ m)
      (systemNextSelected_spec r (m + 1)).1).hom.app
        ((derivedSystemEvaluation (selectedSystemRings B r)
          (systemNextSelected r (m + 1))).obj N) ≫
    ((systemTensorCoherence S).derivedAssoc B (systemNextSelected_spec r m).1
      (r.monotone (systemNextSelected_mono r m))).inv.app
        ((derivedSystemEvaluation (selectedSystemRings B r)
          (systemNextSelected r (m + 1))).obj N) ≫
    (systemDerivedTensor S B (systemNextSelected_spec r m).1).map
      (((systemDerivedTensorAdj S (selectedSystemRings B r)
        (systemNextSelected_mono r m)).homEquiv _ _).symm
          ((systemDerivedTransition (selectedSystemRings B r)
            (systemNextSelected_mono r m)).app N)) ≫
    (systemSelectedDerivedBelow B r m S (systemTensorCoherence S)).inv.app N
```

proof.text: Apply the general transition coherence theorem to the selected derived adjunction and its evaluation comparisons. Their normalized Hom equations at the identity give the two required unit-transpose equations. The actual derived transitions compose, and selected evaluation commutes with transitions, so the right cocone composition equation holds. Canonical tensor coherence was defined by exactly these scalar adjoint-uniqueness comparisons. Thus the generic mate equation is the displayed selected transition formula.
